The '''Norgk Clan Fortress''' was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. Formerly a stronghold of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Norgk clan]], the fortress was at one point obliterated. The ruins were located close to the [[Glonnk clan]] [[Glonnk Clan Fortress|fortress]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
